# Bunizao's Website

Personal website for Bunizao, including project notes, live status widgets, and a Mood feed sourced from a Telegram channel.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://buxx.me/) - Main personal site and project overview.
- [Moods](https://buxx.me/mood) - Public Mood feed with short posts, media, quotes, reactions, and comments.
- [Mood RSS](https://buxx.me/mood/rss.xml) - RSS feed for recent Mood posts.

## Programmatic Access

- [Agent Mood Markdown](https://buxx.me/agent/mood) - Compact Markdown view of recent Mood posts for LLM and agent reading.
- [Agent Mood Post Markdown](https://buxx.me/agent/mood/{id}) - Compact Markdown view for one Mood post.
- [Mood feed JSON](https://buxx.me/api/moods) - Current JSON payload used by the Mood feed UI. Supports cursor pagination with `before` and `after`; use this for recent feed inspection.
- [Mood probe JSON](https://buxx.me/api/moods?probe=1) - Lightweight endpoint returning the latest Mood id.

## Notes For Agents

- Prefer `/agent/mood` for concise Markdown reading.
- Use `/agent/mood/{id}` when you already know the Mood id and need only one post.
- Prefer the RSS feed for simple chronological subscription.
- Prefer `/api/moods` when you need structured fields such as ids, timestamps, text previews, media hints, quotes, reactions, and comment counts.
- Treat `/api/moods` as a feed-oriented payload. It may include presentation fields such as HTML snippets and image layout metadata.
- Individual Mood entries use canonical URLs in the form `https://buxx.me/mood/{id}`.
